g.text: Post-training loop: GRPO with Miles, HealthBench rubric reward
One training step (one rollout id) of modal/miles_rft.py. Miles = radixark/miles v0.1.1, Qwen3.5-4B, full fine-tune.
One Modal container: 4 × H100, Miles' image, Ray head + Miles train.py
colocated: SGLang (rollout) and FSDP (training) take turns on the same 4 GPUs
each row's metadata: conversation, train_criteria, heldout_criteria
4 engines × 1 GPU; Qwen3.5-4B, chat template applied, thinking off
grades the response on the conversation's training criteria only,
one judge call per criterion (~8 per sample, ~1,000 per step)
reward = rubric score = points of criteria met (negatives subtract)
full fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B on the same 4 GPUs
policy loss: PPO clip, ε_low 0.2 / ε_high 0.28
KL to the reference model: logged, coefficient 0
Adam, lr 1e-6; 1 optimizer step per rollout
Every 10 steps: in-loop eval (never a reward)
64 val conversations × 2 samples, same SGLang engines
graded on the held-out criteria, same judge
W&B + TensorBoard: reward, KL, clip fraction, TIS,
After training: offline eval (never a reward)
